enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.description: Greatly improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.description: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Heal Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies. You have additional time to perform the reload.

perks.name: Discord
perks.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

enhanced.name: Discord
enhanced.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a longer duration. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

enhanced.name: Bait and Switch
enhanced.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Controlled Burst
enhanced.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for an improved duration.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

enhanced.name: Desperate Measures
enhanced.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.description: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

enhanced.name: Reservoir Burst
enhanced.description: When the battery is full, your next burst is improved, dealing additional damage and causing targets to explode when defeated.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

enhanced.name: Burning Ambition
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage more quickly scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.
